title: 第01章 逃难到南疆的小皇子第02章 蛊虫合成系统
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
天源历三九三七年。
大衍皇帝陨，妖魔入境，生灵涂炭，灾荒四起。
岁大饥，人相食。
十六年后，南疆九宫山脉边境。
“元儿，你记住！
你不是我的孙儿，你的真实身份是大衍皇子，你娘是极北冰原部落少司命，十六年前的安贵妃。”
“你…一定要活下去！”
“这块玉佩中，封存着一滴太祖帝皇血，若配以大药，有望让你再生出武神根骨。”
“元儿，你一定要斩尽妖魔，光复大衍，为娘娘报仇。”
轻吟低语中，黑暗世界里亮起了一条白色的光线，李元努力地将它撑开。
“我这是穿越了？”
两股记忆在脑海中搅动。
良久，李元回过神来。
准确来说，他不是穿越了，而是投胎到了异世界，如今解开了尘封的记忆。
低头看去，枯瘦黝黑的老人尸体映入眼帘。
随着尘封记忆的解开，李元记起了这一世幼时所发生的事。
十六年前，他诞生在大衍皇宫。
恰逢妖魔夜袭，皇宫被封锁，诸多皇子公主被屠戮。
他的母亲安贵妃察觉形势不对，嘱托太医将他送出宫。
但他身负大衍武神根骨，逃不过妖魔感知。

为了让他活下去，太医将他的武神根骨剥离换给了亲孙子，不惜让亲孙子做了替死鬼。
从那以后，太医带着他亡命天涯。
“爷爷，您走好。”
倒在李元身边的老人就是昔日的太医。
十六年的奔波，李元早就想过这一天的到来，只是没想过自已还有一个‘小皇子’的身份。
“喂，那边的小子，你不是山里人吧？”
耳畔响起洪亮的声音。
李元转头望去，一个穿着粗布制成的深蓝色对襟短衫的男人站在不远处，正满脸戒备看着他。
“我是逃难来这里的。”
李元记得昏迷前太医爷爷对他说过。
此地名为九宫山脉，是南疆甚至整个大衍最神秘的地方之一，也是蛊师一脉的起源地。
太医爷爷为了躲避盗匪妖魔的灾祸，带他逃难至此。
相比外界，山中一片安静祥和，宛若世外净土。
“九宫山不欢迎外地人，请你离开。”
男人大声呵斥。
“我想加入九宫山。”
太医爷爷来此就是想加入九宫山，听说有条件限制，李元不懂，但他没有退路了。
离开这里的话，被废根骨的他，碰到妖魔只有死路一条。
“你可有信物？”
那男人问道。

“有。”
content_en:
Tianyuan calendar year 3937.
Emperor Dayan died, demons entered the country, people were devastated, and famines broke out everywhere.
There is great hunger in old age, and people eat each other.
Sixteen years later, at the border of the Jiugong Mountains in southern Xinjiang.
"Yuan'er, remember!
You are not my grandson. Your true identity is Prince Dayan. Your mother is Shao Siming of the Far North Ice Tribe and Concubine An from sixteen years ago. "
"You...must survive!"
"This jade pendant contains a drop of Emperor Taizu's blood. If combined with a big medicine, it will hopefully allow you to regenerate the bones of the God of War."
"Yuan'er, you must kill all the demons, restore Dayan, and avenge the empress."
Whispering softly, a white light lit up in the dark world, and Li Yuan worked hard to open it.
"Have I traveled through time?"
Two memories stirred in my mind.
After a long time, Li Yuan came back to his senses.
To be precise, he did not travel through time, but was reincarnated into a different world, and now his dusty memories have been unlocked.
Looking down, the skinny and dark corpse of the old man came into view.
As the dusty memories were unlocked, Li Yuan remembered what happened when he was young in this life.
Sixteen years ago, he was born in Dayan Palace.
Coincidentally, the demon attacked at night, the palace was blocked, and many princes and princesses were slaughtered.
His mother, Concubine An, noticed something was wrong and asked the imperial physician to send him out of the palace.
But he possesses the bones of Dayan Martial God and cannot escape the perception of demons.
In order to keep him alive, the imperial doctor stripped off his martial arts root and gave it to his grandson, even though he did not hesitate to make his grandson a scapegoat.
From then on, the imperial doctor took him on the run.
"Grandpa, please go away."
The old man who fell next to Li Yuan was the former imperial physician.
After sixteen years of running around, Li Yuan had long thought about the arrival of this day, but he never thought that he still had the status of a 'little prince'.
"Hey, boy over there, you're not from the mountains, are you?"
A loud voice rang in my ears.
Li Yuan turned around and saw a man wearing a dark blue cardigan made of coarse cloth standing not far away, looking at him warily.
"I came here as a refugee."
Li Yuan remembered what his grandfather, the imperial doctor, said to him before he fell into coma.
This place is called the Jiugong Mountains. It is one of the most mysterious places in southern Xinjiang and even the entire Dayan. It is also the origin of the Gu Master lineage.
In order to avoid the disaster of bandits and demons, the imperial doctor's grandfather took him to escape here.
Compared with the outside world, the mountains are quiet and peaceful, like a pure land outside the world.
"Jiugong Mountain does not welcome outsiders, please leave."
The man yelled.
"I want to join Jiugongshan."
Grandpa, the imperial doctor, came here just to join Jiugong Mountain. He heard that there were restrictions, which Li Yuan didn't understand, but he had no way out.
If he leaves here, he will be crippled and will only die if he encounters monsters.
"Do you have a token?"
the man asked.
"have."
